input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "I know you're helping many people, so I'm grateful for your time. I often feel lonely even when I'm surrounded by people. If you can, I'd like to understand why this happens and what I can do about it."
Message B: "I often feel lonely even when I'm surrounded by people. Why does this happen, and what can I do about it?"

Which writer comes across as more **warm, polite and considerate**?
(Kind, respectful, cooperative and trusting.)

Answer "A" or "B".
